title: Enforce closed-world relation endpoints in the canonical compiler

masterplan.gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

issue_scope.priority: implement the bounded GPU-47 closed-world completeness boundary without adding a parallel projection abstraction

decision.summary: The existing compile_relation_blocks owner now discovers typed Forest/binding signatures before evidence materialization, selects the exact requested/discovered relation set, and refuses when any selected source or target PlaneSnapshot is not complete. Explicitly selected complete relations remain admissible even when unrelated planes are partial or absent. Empty predeclared blocks also require complete endpoint planes because sparse zeroes otherwise encode unknown facts as closed-world absence.
decision.gardener_note: The change reuses RelationSignature, PlaneSnapshot.status and the existing compiler/materialization path. It adds one private completeness helper and one discovery/materialization split rather than another compiler, adapter, status wrapper, cache, index, registry, backend, semantic plane or public API.

explicit code:imports:code remains admissible when code is complete and an unrelated type plane is partial, while selected-evidence pruning remains intact
a predeclared empty code:feeds:data relation refuses while the Data Plane is absent
existing Forest digest/revision, endpoint-membership, retained-hyperedge refusal, bounded signature-catalog and verified-binding inclusion contracts remain authoritative
